messages:
Alex Chen: Hey — urgent heads up, need to swap tonight's primary. Family emergency, flying out. I'm primary for the 20:00-04:00 UTC window. Can someone take primary? I'm happy to do the warm handoff in the next 20m. :wave:
Priya Nair: I can take it for that window. Quick Q — any ongoing incidents? :point_up:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Active alert: increased token-latency on embeddings-service in us-east-1. Severity: P2. Started ~17:02 UTC. Pager routed to primary.
Alex Chen: there's a small latency blip that started ~30m ago; I opened runbook steps. Link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency-surge
Marcos Silva: Priya — if you're taking primary, two quick runbook pointers: check cache-eviction job (cron: cache/evict-embeds), and verify KV cache warmup.
Priya Nair: Got it. Alex can you drop the package of commands you normally run for handoff? Also any active oncall annotations?
Alex Chen: Sure — handoff checklist:
```
# reassign pager
/oncall assign primary @Priya Nair
# confirm infra health
kubectl get pods -n inference | grep embeddings
# quick tail logs
kubectl logs -f deploy/embeds-service -n inference --since=10m
```
Also leaving a note in /incidents/embeddings-latency-1710
Jenna Ortiz: I'll shadow as secondary for that window. If anything escalates to P1 I can take over pagers for 30m while Priya runs mitigation.
Priya Nair: Reassigning now... done. /oncall assign primary @Priya Nair :white_check_mark:
oncall-scheduler-bot: Pager reassigned: primary -> Priya Nair (effective now). Next rotation still Marcos on 2026-09-04 08:00 UTC.
Priya Nair: Quick check — where's the flamegraph link? I saw a spike but not sure if it's GPU-related.
Marcos Silva: flamegraphs uploaded to: https://s3.redwood-prod/ops/embeds/1710/flamegraph.html
IncidentBot: New event: error-rate increased from 0.2% -> 1.8% in us-east-1. Suggested mitigation: disable expensive rerank by toggling feature-flag `embeds_rerank_v2`.
Priya Nair: I toggled the flag to off via console and tested a sample request — latency dropped ~40%. Leaving it off until 04:30 UTC unless we need rollbacks. :thumbsup:
Alex Chen: Thanks, Priya. I'm going to handoff full context in runbook thread and sign out. Leaving a short checklist in case you need quick rollback:
- rollback flag: enable `embeds_rerank_v2`
- restart pods: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/embeds-service -n inference`
- increase burst limit: infra -> quota manager
Priya Nair: Copy. I'll monitor dashboard and post any anomalies. Jenna, if I need a quick escalation ping you.
Jenna Ortiz: Standby. Also I added a short runbook snippet to the incident ticket for quicker handoffs in the future.
Alex Chen: One last note — my flight ETA changed, but I should be reachable via DMs until 21:00 UTC. Thanks everyone. :heart:
Priya Nair: All good, taking over. Closing handoff.
